purpose: Review a finite issuer commercial-pricing, regulated-rate and selling-terms disclosure domain before opening source rows, document text, business-price values, candidate values, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.security_price_boundary: Daily/minute security prices, IPO valuation, block-trade discounts, convertible terms and cross-asset prices are terminal or separately governed sources; none may be relabeled as issuer pricing power.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current price list, tariff table, product catalog or commercial policy cannot be projected backward without effective dates, first-public timestamps and revision history.
repository_evidence.domain_distinction: Business prices and regulated rates are issuer operating states rather than exchange-traded security prices, but the repository has no complete point-in-time local contract for them.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: exact official exchange filing, issuer announcement, regulator order or tariff publication source with immutable bytes and document identifier
first public timestamp, trading-session availability, effective date, correction, withdrawal, supersession and revision chain
issuer, listed security, subsidiary, brand, geography, customer class, product, service and regulated franchise mapping without current-state leakage
price taxonomy separating list, invoice, transaction, average selling, reimbursement, tariff, fee, surcharge, rebate, discount, promotion and bundled price
currency, tax, unit, grade, specification, package, delivery term, contract term and inflation-indexation semantics
old price, new price, percentage change, absolute change, effective-period and partial-scope semantics without inferring undisclosed baselines
regulated proposal, consultation, approval, implementation, suspension, appeal and retroactive-adjustment event identity
gross versus net price, volume mix, product mix, geographic mix, consolidation scope and internal-transfer exclusions
missing, undisclosed, unknown, not-applicable, true zero, temporary promotion and unchanged-price semantics without favorable absence coding
industry comparability and deterministic exclusion rules for nonfungible products or incompatible tariff bases
complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest, full-market denominator, delisting coverage, pagination and one-shot acceptance gates
parser, identity, timing, unit and source-acceptance tests using no candidate, comparator, security-price or return values

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: issuer_product_or_service_price_adjustment_disclosure
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A historically published change in the issuer's commercial price for a defined product or service.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted history freezes exact product scope, old/new price, currency and unit, effective date, first-public time, revisions, transaction-versus-list semantics and full 2019-2023 coverage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: regulated_tariff_fee_or_reimbursement_rate_adjustment
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A regulator-authorized change in the rate paid to or charged by the issuer for a regulated service or product.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Proposal, approval and implementation stages, jurisdiction, customer class, rate base, retroactivity, appeals, issuer exposure, first availability and complete denominator are not frozen.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: average_selling_price_or_unit_revenue_disclosure
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A recurring disclosed realization of net price per physical unit or service unit.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Gross/net price, volume and product mix, unit identity, period scope, restatements, first-public time and comparable full-market history lack an accepted contract.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: discount_rebate_promotion_surcharge_or_commercial_term_change
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A historically published change in net commercial terms that can alter realized pricing or demand.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Temporary versus structural terms, customer eligibility, bundling, duration, net-price effect, contract scope, first availability and revisions are not available under a complete accepted source contract.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: security_market_price_discount_or_cross_asset_price_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: An exchange-traded or issuance price statistic relabeled as product pricing power.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Daily/minute prices, IPO price/valuation, block-trade discounts and convertible/cross-asset terms are already terminal or separately governed. They do not become a new business-price state through naming.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: price_change_magnitude_direction_pass_through_benchmark_or_window_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A transform of a business-price observation against costs, peers, inflation, volume or time.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing higher/lower direction, magnitude threshold, duration, lag, cost pass-through, peer benchmark, inflation residual or demand interaction before base-source admission would multiply hypotheses and is especially unsafe because price increases can signal either power or cost pressure.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_pricing_power_breadth_persistence_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Joint issuer exposure across commercial prices, regulated rates, realized unit prices and selling terms.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining four unadmitted and heterogeneous price families or selecting weights, ranks, persistence filters and models would expand the search before any component has a complete source contract.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Four distinct business-pricing states remain deferred at source admission; security-price relabeling, premature direction/operator search and unadmitted combinations are closed before values.

next_action: Record all seven decisions in the Campaign169 hash chain, publish terminal accounting, and continue a different finite offline prevalue domain.
